scope: Deterministic U2 structural substrate and read-only R21B adapters. Native structural commands are simulator bookkeeping; no new participant paid operations are claimed.

cases.name: instances
cases.setup: Two objects share a definition and equal values.
cases.criterion: Keep distinct instance identities, custody, and histories.

cases.name: nonmental_material
cases.setup: Create a tool with material roles and no cognitive capability.
cases.criterion: Supported material interactions work without allocating a full mind.

cases.name: relation_identity
cases.criterion: Preserve participants, scope, prior revision, and causal provenance.

cases.name: hypothesis
cases.criterion: Record the hypothesis without adding an actual physical event.

cases.name: historical_revision
cases.setup: Change a definition or interpretation after a remembered event.
cases.criterion: Reconstruct the earlier meaning without consulting only the mutable head.

cases.name: split_merge
cases.setup: Divide and combine objects under declared material laws.
cases.criterion: Keep explicit lineage and enforce resource ownership.

cases.name: finite_cycle
cases.setup: A member represents a group that contains the member.
cases.criterion: Use finite references without recursive whole-world copying.

cases.name: legacy_adapter
cases.setup: Convert a legacy Ref, transaction, and checkpoint into the object form and back.
cases.criterion: Exactly recover all promised legacy data and its protected semantic projection.

additional_checks: optimistic revision conflict and atomic batch rejection
allowlisted codec and invalid replay rejection
definition source status and optional roles
all legacy Ref kinds and all codec-supported record families via structural adapter
legacy participant view isolation and paid partial continuation
timing_acceptance: U13 remains open; no performance gate claimed in U2
